title: "cannot capture 'rclcpp::Node::get_clock()()' by reference" and ROS 2 throttled logs that never print, measured
excerpt: Why RCLCPP_INFO_THROTTLE rejects get_clock() and rclcpp::Duration, why a period of 1 prints every call, why use_sim_time without /clock prints nothing, why a second instance stays silent, and rclpy's ValueError. Measured in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
